name: @vortiqlabs/codebase-indexer
description: A standalone local-first codebase indexing engine

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/src/parser/grammars && cp -R src/parser/grammars/. dist/src/parser/grammars/ && esbuild src/dashboard/graph-client.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --platform=browser --outfile=dist/dashboard/graph-client.js && mkdir -p dist/dashboard/monaco && cp -R node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs dist/dashboard/monaco/
